2026 INFINITI QX60 AUTOGRAPH AWD | Technology Package with ProPILOT Assist 2.1 | Klipsch 20-Speaker Audio | Retired Courtesy Vehicle | Clean CARFAX

Moonbow Blue over Black Obsidian, Saddle Brown quilted semi-aniline leather inside this is not the color combination youll see twice on the same lot. With just 4 miles on the odometer and INFINITI Certified Pre-Owned protection, this 2026 INFINITI QX60 Autograph is the most fully equipped three-row luxury crossover we have in inventory, and its ready for whatever the Hill Country throws at it.

Safety & Driver Assistance ~
The Technology Package elevates this Autograph above the rest of the lineup. ProPILOT Assist 2.1 delivers a more advanced level of hands-on highway driving assistance than the standard 1.1 system, while the 3D Around View Monitor gains Spin Capability for a full rotating perspective around the vehicle.
* Predictive Forward Collision Warning with Forward Emergency Braking and Pedestrian Detection
* Blind Spot Warning with Blind Spot Intervention
* Rear Automatic Braking and Rear Cross Traffic Alert
* Adaptive Front Lighting System with Auto Leveling critical on winding roads toward Fredericksburg after dark
* Dual Camera Drive Recorder front and rear coverage on every drive
* Auto-Dimming Smart Rearview Mirror

Performance & Drivetrain ~
The 2.0L Variable Compression Turbo engine produces up to 268 horsepower and 286 lb-ft of torque through a 9-Speed Automatic Transmission with paddle shifters and INFINITI Intelligent All-Wheel Drive. A factory-installed Tow Hitch with 7-Pin Connector and Trailer Stability Control means this Autograph can handle a weekend trailer to the Guadalupe River or a gear haul out to Bandera Road without breaking a sweat.

Interior & Comfort ~
Saddle Brown Quilted, Semi-Aniline Leather-Appointed seating with Contrast Stitching and Piping sets the cabin tone across the first and second rows, with a Panoramic Illuminated Headliner adding ambient depth overhead.
* 8-way Power Adjustable, Heated, Ventilated, and Massaging Front Seats
* 2nd-Row Heated Captain Chairs with fixed center console
* Power Returning 3rd Row Seat Backs and rear door sunshades
* Advanced Climate Control System
* Power Panoramic Moonroof
* INFINITI Light Path and INFINITI Radiant Dark Illuminated Kick Plates

Technology & Connectivity ~
Three displays define the cockpit a 12.3-Inch INFINITI InTouch Interactive Display, a 12.3-inch Dynamic Meter Display, and a 10.8-Inch Head-Up Display that keeps speed, navigation, and assist data at eye level.
* Klipsch Reference Premiere 20-Speaker Premium Audio System with Individual Audio via Headrest Speakers
* Wireless Apple CarPlay and Wireless Android Auto
* Wireless phone charging
* Google built-in with navigation capability

Exterior & Design ~
Premium Two-Tone paint Moonbow Blue over Black Obsidian over 20-Inch Aluminum-Alloy Wheels with black roof rail crossbars and dark illuminated cargo scuff plates. The motion-activated power rear liftgate, auto-folding heated mirrors, and rain-sensing wipers round out the details.

INFINITI Certified Pre-Owned coverage means this Autograph has cleared a comprehensive inspection and carries extended warranty protection the top-spec three-row luxury crossover for the buyer who wants it all without waiting for a factory order.

Principle INFINITI of Boerne just off I-10 in the heart of Texas Hill Country. Serving San Antonio, Boerne, New Braunfels, and Kerrville. Call 210-477-1794 to schedule a private showing.

Designed to adapt to your lifestyle, the Maverick XLT offers a versatile and functional interior, with ample storage solutions and a user-friendly infotainment system. Stay connected with the SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition, seamlessly integrating your smartphone via Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Whether you're seeking a capable work truck, a versatile family hauler, or a stylish companion for your active lifestyle, the 2025 Ford Maverick XLT is the perfect choice. Visit our showroom today and let us demonstrate how this exceptional Maverick can enhance your driving experience.

Shoppers comparing top-tier family SUVs will appreciate how the X7 seamlessly balances daily convenience, family comfort, and premium features. Unlike some rivals, the X7 includes auto-leveling suspension, benefiting those who value a composed, confident ride regardless of road or cargo conditions.

The 2025 Chevrolet Tahoe LS delivers high long-term ownership value by blending reliability, durability, and strong resale prospects with advanced technology.

Pragmatic buyers seeking a full-size SUV that balances day-to-day usability with long-term reliability will find the Tahoe LS an ideal match. The vehicle’s tech-forward cabin, anchored by a 17.7-inch touchscreen, offers connectivity and ease of use while minimizing distractions. Families, fleet managers, and those who prioritize ease of maintenance and future resale will appreciate its straightforward, durable interior and robust suite of modern convenience features.

A proven powertrain underpins this SUV’s reputation for lasting well beyond 150,000 miles with proper care. The engine and automatic transmission deliver smooth power delivery and dependable performance. Electronic stability control, traction control, and adaptive drive modes optimize the ride for longevity and efficiency, ensuring lower wear on critical components over the long haul. Routine service intervals are straightforward, with oil changes and inspections typically aligning with standard manufacturer recommendations for full-size SUVs, keeping operating costs predictable and manageable.

Long-term safety is supported by an array of active driver assistance features that help protect your investment and your family. Blind-spot monitoring, rearview and exterior cameras, and electronic stability systems actively reduce accident risk, decreasing the likelihood of costly repairs. Automatic high-beam headlights and rain-sensing wipers enhance visibility in all conditions, while OnStar emergency communications provide immediate connection to assistance, further safeguarding occupants and supporting lower insurance claims over time.

Ownership comfort and convenience come standard with the Tahoe LS. The cabin features three-zone climate control, power-adjustable front seats with lumbar support for reduced fatigue, and remote keyless entry for daily practicality. The advanced infotainment suite, highlighted by Google built-in navigation and voice controls, makes every journey efficient and enjoyable. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration allow seamless smartphone connectivity, while a premium six-speaker audio system ensures quality sound for every passenger. These features translate into fewer aftermarket upgrades and lasting satisfaction throughout ownership.

Compared to the Ford Expedition and GMC Yukon, the Tahoe stands out for its blend of advanced digital features and projected lower depreciation. The 17.7-inch touchscreen and Google-powered ecosystem give it a clear edge in day-to-day connectivity. Chevrolet’s established track record for SUV durability also supports stronger resale value and fewer unscheduled repairs versus its main rivals, solidifying its reputation for cost-effective ownership.

Routine oil changes are typically required every 7,500 miles under normal driving conditions, with other service intervals aligned to standard manufacturer guidelines for full-size SUVs. The Tahoe’s projected fuel economy is competitive for its segment, with highway driving offering superior efficiency compared to city use.

Experience smart ownership economics with the 2025 Tahoe LS at Bayway Chevrolet. To explore the vehicle’s advanced tech, robust reliability, and long-term value, visit 5719 Broadway St, Pearland, TX, 77581 or call 281-719-9821. Discover how the Tahoe delivers lasting satisfaction for drivers focused on cost-effective, dependable transportation.

Here at Reed-Lallier Chevrolet we have a No Haggle pricing policy on all of our pre-owned vehicles. We price our vehicles very competitively in the market to give you an extremely fair price right up front. We do not negotiate on the price of the vehicle. Most of our cars are priced at thousands below NADA retail value. We have taken many things into consideration when pricing the cars, exterior condition, miles, interior condition and warranty to name a few. Our cars are priced in the condition that you see them. As with any used vehicle, they have been driven on the road, parked in garages and parking lots and driven through all kinds of weather. Some wear and tear is normal. This may include some small scratches or door dings, interior wear, chips in the windshield etc. We have taken all of these into consideration and priced the vehicles accordingly. All vehicles must pass North Carolina State inspection. Cars come with one key unless otherwise noted or disclosed. Not all cars have second keys. Not all cars have owners manuals. We will be happy to price any parts or repairs that you may desire at our wholesale cost and include them in the deal and in your financing. We have GM Certified vehicles here on the lot, they come with a factory backed extended limited warranty (see dealer for details). Some of our vehicles are still covered under the original factory warranty and are therefore sold with the balance of that warranty in place. Some of our vehicles are sold AS-IS, this means that the buyer is responsible for all repairs. Some vehicles will have open recalls, we will provide all paperwork and disclose any recalls to you before purchase.
